answer: Sybil resistance: gate entry on an unaffiliated underwriter who posts a bond slashed if the newcomer later defaults, and who may back only one live entrant at a time. A farm can forge copper, keys it stamps for free internally, but each clone needs its own ivory bond from a distinct outsider with no tie to the farm. Honest underwriters are a finite external relationship, not minted on demand; the one-slot cap blocks pooling, so the coalition's entry cost climbs with every head.
